name: Cloudcore
summary: Although sky photography has been a fixture of internet aesthetics since the early Tumblr era, Cloudcore became a distinct and named aesthetic primarily between 2019 and 2022, driven by Pinterest boards, TikTok wallpaper accounts, and aesthetic blogs.
description: Although sky photography has been a fixture of internet aesthetics since the early Tumblr era, Cloudcore became a distinct and named aesthetic primarily between 2019 and 2022, driven by Pinterest boards, TikTok wallpaper accounts, and aesthetic blogs. During this period, the word "aesthetic" itself became an aesthetic, defined in this context as a sensibility characterized by soft editing, dreamy color palettes, and an atmosphere of gentle aspiration. Cloudcore was one of the purest expressions of that moment.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Softness, serenity, wonder, escapism, beauty

visualDNA.colour: Dusty lavender, rose pink, baby blue, teal, iridescent white, golden orange
